text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic complete hollow outfit, no person, skin or visible mannequin, pure white seamless background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, fully uncropped. Garments: Black fluid long-sleeve shirt with rolled forearms and open pointed collar, dark espresso wide-leg trousers, black shoes.. Add ONLY these accessories: A narrow long black soft scarf, fully visible, draped in a loose open loop with both ends.; A fine silver chain necklace with tiny pendant, complete closed chain loop.; Black smooth leather belt with simple silver rectangular buckle, complete belt shown in a loose oval.; A medium black soft leather handbag with short rounded handles and relaxed slouchy body.. Use each accessory once. Neckties are tied with one knot and the narrow tail hidden; for sweater layers tuck the long tail under the sweater. No additional accessories or props.
original_prompt: Create ONE complete photorealistic hollow wardrobe outfit on a pure white background, portrait 2:3, soft studio light. FIRST reference is the exact clothing base; preserve its cuts, colors, layers and footwear. Other references are individual accessory products belonging to this look. Garments: Black fluid long-sleeve shirt with rolled forearms and open pointed collar, dark espresso wide-leg trousers, black shoes.. Add EXACTLY these accessories and no others: A narrow long black soft scarf, fully visible, draped in a loose open loop with both ends.; A fine silver chain necklace with tiny pendant, complete closed chain loop.; Black smooth leather belt with simple silver rectangular buckle, complete belt shown in a loose oval.; A medium black soft leather handbag with short rounded handles and relaxed slouchy body.. Arrange as a single cohesive empty outfit: tie at collar, belt at waist, scarf draped naturally, hat/eyewear hovering above empty neck if present, necklace around empty collar; bag beside hip with full strap. Watches, gloves or small jewelry can be placed neatly beside outfit, each once. No visible person, body, face, skin, hands, legs, mannequin, stand or hanger. Empty neck and sleeves. Preserve fully visible garments, shoes, accessory shapes, full chains and straps within frame. No source photos, collages, labels, text, props or watermark.
